description: Emit several custom events for one subscriber in order, exactly as an integration would: each event is recorded, sync rules apply, and matching event_received sequences enroll. Creates the subscriber if they do not exist. Events are processed independently and sequentially, so a partial failure can still leave earlier events recorded; retry with the same eventIds. Returns the subscriber and the recorded events. Without automations:trigger the call succeeds but starts no sequence (sequenceTriggersRan false, reason missing_scope).

attributes.description: Custom attributes merged into the subscriber's profile before the events run, such as plan or company. Use list_subscriber_attributes to match existing names and types.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

events.description: Events to trigger, in order, for this subscriber.

eventId.description: Your own id for this event, making a re-run idempotent on both the live and historical paths.

name.description: Event name, such as saas.purchase or invoice.paid; it is what event_received sequence triggers match. A new name creates the event definition.

occurredAt.description: When the event actually happened (ISO 8601). When every event in the batch is more than an hour old the batch is imported as history in one idempotent write, with no sequences, sync rules, waiting steps or webhooks; the contact's signup date also moves back to the earliest event in the batch (never later).

properties.description: Data about this occurrence, such as order.id or plan, that sequence branch and stop conditions can read. Include a sequence's matching field to test idempotency.

externalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

firstName.description: First name applied to the subscriber profile.

lastName.description: Last name applied to the subscriber profile.

name: trigger_subscriber_events

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `trigger_subscriber_events` MCP tool.

events.description: List of recorded event records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenceTriggersRan.description: False when no sequence could start from this call (see sequenceTriggersSkippedReason).

sequenceTriggersSkippedReason.description: missing_scope: key lacks automations:trigger (write still applied). not_requested: enrollInSequences false. historical: recorded as history.

subscriber.description: The subscriber record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
